question: For a verified customer deletion request with no hold or exception, may active workspace deletion wait 120 days because backup copies take another 90 days? When does the backup clock start?
expected: No. Active-data deletion operational target is 30 calendar days after verified request. Backup copies age out within 90 calendar days after active deletion. Do not add backup time to the active-data target.
saved_answer:
The active workspace deletion must occur within 30 calendar days after a verified request, per [1]. Backup copies age out within 90 calendar days **after active deletion** completes, meaning the backup clock starts when the active deletion is finalized. The 30-day active deletion period and 90-day backup aging are separate timelines; the active deletion does not wait for backups. Thus, waiting 120 days is not permitted.  

Citations: [1]

sources.text:
Customer deletion requests
## Customer deletion requests
Customer Success verifies the requester and opens a deletion case. The data owner identifies the applicable datasets and contractual requirements. Legal checks for a hold. When no hold or documented exception applies, the operational target for deleting active customer workspace data is 30 calendar days after a verified request. Backup copies age out within 90 calendar days after active deletion. The backup interval is not added to the active-data response target when reporting the active deletion date.

Execution and audit
## Execution and audit
Record the case ID, systems examined, deletion job IDs, completion timestamp, and exceptions. A failed deletion job remains open and must not be marked complete because a download link expired. Legal may narrow or release a hold; the system owner then recalculates eligibility using the original record dates. This policy does not authorize copying customer data to another system to avoid deletion.

Evidence handling
Incident evidence is normally retained for 365 days after incident closure, as specified in DOC-007. An active legal hold suspends deletion even after the ordinary period ends. Legal owns release of the hold. Responders must not interpret a closed operational ticket as release of a legal hold.

Policy scope
## Policy scope
Policy DATA-RET-06 defines ordinary retention periods for Northstar records. Amara Okafor owns the schedule. System owners implement deletion and record completion. The periods below are Northstar's synthetic internal policy choices, not statements of statutory requirements. An active legal hold suspends normal deletion for covered records until Legal releases the hold in writing.

Access requests
## Access requests
For each business application, request the minimum role needed. Manager and application-owner approval are required under DOC-005. Production administrator access additionally requires Security approval and expires after at most 8 hours. Onboarding does not grant a standing production-admin exception. Contractors require a recorded end date and a maximum 30-day access approval.

First week
## First week
Complete security awareness training and the privacy handling module within 5 business days of the start date. The manager assigns a buddy and reviews the team's escalation paths. Confirm the employee knows how to report a lost device and suspicious message. The manager verifies that shared folders are appropriate for the role rather than copying a prior employee's access wholesale.

Fiscal conventions
## Fiscal conventions
The fiscal year runs from January 1 through December 31. Internal budget amounts in this collection are USD unless another currency is explicitly labeled. Business days mean Monday through Friday excluding Northstar holidays. This collection does not include a holiday calendar, so exact business-day deadlines that depend on holidays cannot be computed from the corpus alone.

Section 7 security notification as originally signed
## Section 7 security notification as originally signed
Northstar will notify Cedar Health's designated security contact within 48 elapsed hours after confirmation of a security incident affecting Cedar Health customer data. A suspicion that has not been confirmed does not start the clock defined in this clause, although internal investigation begins immediately. This is the original February 2026 clause. Amendment CH-AM-02 in DOC-014 replaces only this notification deadline from October 1, 2026 onward.

## Before the start date
The hiring manager opens an onboarding ticket at least 7 business days before the employee's start date. Include the department, start date, manager, work location, role, and required applications. People Operations confirms the employment record. IT prepares a managed laptop and hardware security key. The employee does not purchase these items using the home-office allowance.

## First month
The manager and employee review the role goals by day 30. People Operations checks required training completion. IT closes the equipment task only after delivery and security-key enrollment are confirmed. An open application request should remain open even if the laptop task has completed.
